description: A written note or a MIDI number. Middle C is C4, which is 60. C-1 is 0 and G9 is 127. The name you pass keeps its spelling, so B#3 stays B#3 even though it is the same key as C4. sharp and flat are the two usual names of that key. x is a double sharp. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/midi-note
